title: Reject invalid pipeline input
description: Require a named pipeline run with passing checks before emitting a deploy payload.
program: ASSERT(input.checks != null, "Pipeline checks array is required")
ASSERT(LENGTH(input.checks) > 0, "At least one pipeline check is required")
ASSERT(EVERY(input.checks, (check) -> check.name != null), "Every check needs a name")
ASSERT(EVERY(input.checks, (check) -> check.status == "passed" || check.status == "failed"), "Unknown pipeline check status")

exercise.instruction: Change package status from passed to failed, then run again. Expect an error and no deploy payload.

edgeCases.name: Empty checks are rejected
edgeCases.expectedError: At least one pipeline check is required

recipe.problem: Refuse to create a deployment payload when the pipeline feed is incomplete, empty, or reports an unsuccessful check.
prerequisites: run_id and branch are required text identifiers. checks is a required nonempty array.
Every check has a name and status passed or failed. Pending, skipped, missing, and unknown statuses must not authorize deployment.
explanation: ASSERT stops execution on the first violated requirement, before OUTPUT is reached.
An explicit nonempty check prevents EVERY on an empty array from authorizing a deploy.
Only a run whose checks all passed reaches OUTPUT. The payload preserves run_id, branch, and the checked names.
limits: This is a data gate, not a deployment command or authorization system.
A trusted producer must supply the complete expected check list. One supplied passing check does not prove other required checks ran.
Branch protection, identity, timestamps, signatures, and allowed branches need separate policies.
